# Bid the liner, the access, and the extras.

> Price crawl space encapsulation from floor area, liner-only versus sealed encapsulate, hatch versus belly-crawl versus wet access, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $4 / sq ft special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
